With James Gunn and Peter Safran out as the co-heads of DC Studios following Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, it's unclear what will become of the cinematic universe that was building around movies like last year's Superman. Though Gunn's Man of Tomorrow feature might still come out, it seems like his larger vision for the DC Universe may be tossed out by DC Studios' newly appointed CEO, Jeremy Latcham. Gunn was taking his time fleshing out the DCU with relatively less high-profile characters like Peacemaker, Supergirl, and Clayface.
